result.details: Resident-server probe reached the fused QK RoPE path and did not return after several minutes. Server log showed sharded tilize warnings but no handler exception. Client was killed; serve_tp.sh stop required SIGTERM; qb2 devices were reset with tt-smi -r 0,1,2,3.

workflow_decision: Invalidate rotary_embedding_llama_fused_qk as a production-path candidate for this qb2 mesh/layout until a smaller isolated probe proves it cannot wedge. Do not claim a speedup.

server_recovery.note: Server must be restarted after syncing the guard that disables this path by default.
